intro_zh: 手柄已经连上 Mac，菜单能动，回到地图却不顺手：地块光标、镜头和轮盘像在使用不同的输入规则。我做的这个小模组专门处理 Mac 地图和菜单输入兼容，把已经被系统识别的手柄接到更一致的游戏操作上。
intro_en: Your controller is connected to the Mac and can navigate menus, but the map feels inconsistent. I made Mac Controller Support Fix for that gap: plot selection, camera input and access to the radial menu when the controller is already recognized by the system.
limits_zh: 独立工坊版本为 0.1.5。已有实体 Xbox 手柄反馈来自较早的 0.1.3；0.1.5 菜单输入更新有离线验证，仍需补齐实机复测。范围以普通地图状态为主，不保证城市操作等所有上下文，也不能修复系统根本识别不到手柄的问题。安装环境按项目说明配置 Steam Input；不同手柄型号仍需反馈。
limits_en: The standalone Workshop release is 0.1.5. Physical Xbox controller feedback comes from the earlier 0.1.3 version; the 0.1.5 menu-input update has offline coverage but still needs in-game retesting. This mainly targets the ordinary map context, not every city or selection mode, and cannot fix a controller the operating system does not recognize. Follow the project’s Steam Input setup notes; other controller models still need feedback.

sections.zh: 让地块选择和镜头移动正常接上
sections.pain_zh: 明明能在菜单里操作，进入地图后摇杆却不能稳定控制自己想要的东西。
sections.fix_zh: 兼容层补齐左摇杆的地块选择与镜头跟随，以及右摇杆的镜头移动，让地图输入走到相应的游戏动作。
sections.pain_en: A controller may work in menus while map sticks fail to reach the intended actions.
sections.fix_en: The compatibility layer connects left-stick plot selection and camera following, plus right-stick camera movement, to the relevant map actions.
sections.shot: 必须使用独立 0.1.5 安装版拍地图移动终点，并留实体手柄记录；不能复用另一个 Mod 的截图。

sections.zh: 把离开的光标带回眼前
sections.en: Bring the plot cursor back into view
sections.pain_zh: 镜头已经移到另一片区域，地块选择还留在远处，想继续操作就得来回找。
sections.fix_zh: 按下 R3，把选中地块带到当前镜头中心。移动的是选择位置，镜头留在你正在看的地方。
sections.pain_en: The camera is where you want it, but the selected plot is far away.
sections.fix_en: Press R3 to bring the selected plot to the current camera center. The selection moves; the camera stays where you are looking.
sections.shot: 独立版 R3 后中心地块选中，另存操作前画面核验移动的是光标而非镜头。

sections.zh: 两根摇杆，各用各的上下方向
sections.en: Give each stick its own vertical direction
sections.pain_zh: 选地块时习惯向上就是向上，推镜头时却可能习惯反转，一个统一开关很难兼顾。
sections.fix_zh: 左右摇杆的上下方向分别设置，默认左摇杆不反转、右摇杆反转。选项放在原生设置里，可以确认保存或取消这次修改。
sections.pain_en: Plot selection and camera panning can feel better with different vertical directions.
sections.fix_en: Each stick has a separate inversion setting. Defaults are non-inverted on the left and inverted on the right, with native confirm and cancel controls in the options page.
sections.shot: 独立版设置页两个反转开关，需补确认保存、退出重开验证后才能称设置已实测。

sections.zh: 轮盘与菜单跟上摇杆输入
sections.en: Make the radial menu and menus respond
sections.pain_zh: 地图上想打开工具轮盘，或进入菜单后想继续用左摇杆，却遇到部分输入没有反应。
sections.fix_zh: 普通地图状态补齐轮盘入口，单位和菜单上下文保留各自动作。0.1.5 还补了菜单摇杆输入兼容；这次更新的实机复测结果会单独说明，不把离线通过写成所有菜单都已验证。
sections.pain_en: Opening the map wheel or continuing with the left stick in a menu can expose gaps in input handling.
sections.fix_en: The ordinary map context gets a radial-menu route while unit and menu contexts keep their own actions. Version 0.1.5 also adds menu-stick compatibility; its in-game retest remains distinct from the offline checks.
sections.shot: 独立 0.1.5 轮盘已打开并高亮选项；记录实际触发按键与当前上下文。

approval: 既有手柄文章已授权发布；本次其他新稿等待用户验收，不发布。
